_inspectorSnowReport.Report:
Thursday April 9th| 5:39 a.m 

Bonjour Tremblant!

It’s Thursday morning, and it’s shaping up to be another absolutely incredible day on the mountain! Honestly, it’s hard to get over just how epic this season has been.

Today brings mild temperatures, a southern breeze, and plenty of beautiful sunshine from start to finish—perfect conditions for a classic spring skiing day.

Our mountain crews have been working nonstop and are delivering an unreal number of runs. We’re beyond impressed with the conditions out there right now, with a fantastic mix of freshly groomed trails, terrain parks, and glade skiing available across the mountain.

Please note that the Edge side of the mountain is now closed for the season.
The Porte du Soleil chairlift is also closed for the season.

At 4:00 this afternoon, join us at the base of the south side for our inter-department race, La Coupe Carton! Each department on the mountain builds a creative (and often hilarious) cardboard-and-tape contraption, then races it down the slope. It’s always a fun and entertaining spectacle for all ages. Guests are warmly invited to come watch and enjoy the action at the end of the day!

Don’t miss out—come up and enjoy this stunning spring day with us!

Mountain safety tip of the week: Respect the signage / No reckless behavior will be tolerated!
The Mountain Operations team installs various forms of signage to help skiers move safely on the mountain. Please respect all signs and warnings, and do not venture off-piste or onto closed runs. These areas may conceal unexpected hazards.

Snow fall is recorded daily at 5 a.m from mid-mountain at North Side (550 m / 1,800 ft). This data, based on 24 hours, provides a picture of on-mountain conditions. Actual accumulation may differ from the official report. Be aware of changing conditions. Lifts and trails exist in a mountain environment and may close due to weather, usage and/or special maintenance.
